notes.title: Alpaca Ball Easter Update!
notes.content:
Hey!

Just in time for Easter celebrations, I am back with two cool new additions to our Alpaca Ball roster.

Enjoy your matches over the holidays with two Easter themed Alpacas.

- Mat

notes.title: The Return of Lunar New Year Celebration!
notes.content:
Hey!

Lunar New Year is around the corner and to celebrate that we are updating Alpaca Ball with [b]two brand-new Alpacas[/b]!

I hope you enjoy the newest additions to our ever growing roster of playable Alpacas. There are even more to come in future updates, so keep your eyes peeled. ːsteamhappyː

-Mathias

notes.title: Alpaca Ball: Allstars is coming to more home consoles in 2022!
notes.content:
Hey fellow alpacas,

We have some exciting news to share with you about Alpaca Ball: Allstars, which is celebrating its 1st anniversary today!

First, we are happy to announce Leoful has become the global publisher for Alpaca Ball: Allstars across all platforms.

With this new partnership, we are excited to reveal Alpaca Ball: Allstars is heading to more home consoles, such as PS5 and PS4, in 2022.

Last but not least, a new edition of Alpaca Ball: Allstars has been released on the Nintendo Switch in the Americas, Europe, and Australia. 

If you own the Alpaca Ball: Allstars Legacy Edition*, you can download the new edition** for free via Nintendo eShop. The new edition features a new stage and costumes from the Japanese Summer Festival update, Asian language support, and support for all future updates.

For more Alpaca Ball: Allstars news, please follow us on Facebook, Twitter, or Discord.

[b]Leoful[/b]
Facebook: https://fb.com/LeofulGames
Twitter: https://twitter.com/LeofulGames
Discord: https://discord.gg/tt9jztAAXv
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCFhK4V7tjXPkYIWwYmbkz6A/

[b]Salt Castle Studio[/b]
Twitter: https://twitter.com/Salt_Castle

[i]* Support for the Alpaca Ball: Allstars Legacy Edition on Nintendo Switch has been discontinued. It will not receive any updates in the future.
** No further action is required for customers living in Asia, as the Asian version is already on the new edition.[/i]

notes.title: Celebrate the summer with a brand new japanese inspired pitch!
notes.content:
Hey!

A new update for Alpaca Ball: Allstars just dropped, with another fantastic new pitch for you to enjoy.

Celebrate the summer by visiting the new pitch, inspired by the various japanese summer festivals.

Also joining you on your visit are two all NEW alpacas, so relive your best memories of binging festival foods and participate in wacky games by playing the update today!

- Mathias

notes.title: The Chaos Update!
notes.content:
Hey!

I am here today to tell you about the newest update releasing for Alpaca Ball: Allstars... THE CHAOS UPDATE!

In the past, we experimented a lot with different dynamic pitches to create completely new situations to add variance to your Alpaca Ball matches. With the Chaos Update we crank that up to 11!

The Chaos Update adds 2 new maps, the [b]Rumble Arena[/b] and the [b]Rumble Stadium[/b]!
In these two maps, dynamic object setups will be randomly chosen from over 20 different setups!

Check out the newest short trailer, to get a quick look at what's possible:

Of course an update from us wouldn't be complete without a few new Alpacas to choose from. The update also adds 2 new Alpaca Players, ready to rumble!

That's it! Get into your jersey and start the rumbling!

- Mathias

notes.title: Lunar New Year Celebration
notes.content:
Hey!

I am back today with a content update for you guys who would like to enjoy the Lunar New Year festivities in Alpaca Ball!

[b]What's in it?[/b]
A completely new pitch, themed around the celebrations, with an interesting fella soaring through the air and messing up your shots left and right. It's another way for me to explore dynamic content happening on the pitch and it was especially fun to create this mythical being ːsteamhappyː

There's still [b]more[/b] content planned for the future, especially to push the whole "dynamic pitch" idea to a WHOLE NOTHER level, so stay tuned!

Have fun with the update and I am wishing you great happiness and prosperity!

Mat

notes.title: The Holiday Update brings you new Alpacas and Pitches!
notes.content:
Happy Holidays!

I am excited to bring you some new alpaca content just in time for the holidays!

The Holiday Update features the first big city pitch in the game, and it's a Christmas market nonetheless!
The Christmas Market pitch is also the first one to feature dynamic elements! It sure can be a train wreck. ːsteammockingː

Come by, drink some hot punch, eat sweets and score some goals with the three new alpaca characters that've been added!

I hope you have a wonderful time over the holidays to close out this bumpy year.

- Mat

notes.title: Alpaca Ball: Allstars OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey!

I am super excited and nervous for today, as today is the day that YOU can play the full version of Alpaca Ball: Allstars for the first time! My alpacas are free to roam the world through your PC, please give them a new home, would you? :)

Play with up to 8 players locally in multiplayer matches, or over Steam Remote Play. But also give the Career Mode a go, solo or with a friend of yours in co-op! Customize your alpaca and please share your best moments, best goals or wonkiest alpacas with me and others through the Steam Community!

[previewyoutube=RNrNT1I0tIQ;full][/previewyoutube]


I hope the game is everything you thought it would be, please leave a Review on the store page after playing!

- Mat

notes.title: What do expect in the Alpaca Ball: Allstars demo
notes.content:
Thank you for showing interest in our demo for Alpaca Ball: Allstars!

Here's what you can expect!

[b]Alpaca Ball: Allstars[/b]

Football with Alpacas! Bring the cup home in this hilarious and chaotic physics-based party game. Play with up to 8 players in versus mode, or tackle the career mode either solo or in 2 player co-op! Peru-ve yourself on the Picchu and win those Machus!

[b]Content of the demo[/b]

[list]
[*] Play the first five levels of the career mode solo or co-op. Dive into the story of an newbie alpaca and make your first moves towards becoming an Alpaca Ball star!

[*] Play the multiplayer mode on Machu Picchu with a special selection of ball types alone or with a friend and up to 2v2.

[*] Customize your alpaca! Figure out all the most fitting alpaca and fur combinations!
[/list]

[b]About us[/b]

We here at Salt Castle Studio are five friends who love bringing people together with games.
Always trying to come up with quirky new ideas, we try to keep people on their toes about what's to come. 

Recently we celebrated our one year anniversary as a studio and we are getting more excited with each day about what the future has in store for us!

[b]Please share your experience with the demo with us, we'd love to hear what you think![/b]
